The background supports **static images, animated GIFs, and looping videos ("},{"id":"p5s4","text":"MP4/WebM/MOV/M4V)** — an uploaded animated GIF is auto-detected and used as a live/dynamic backgroun"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"d, and an uploaded video is auto-detected and played as a full-screen looping background. Out of the"},{"id":"p5s6","text":" box it's a Xiao-style jade/emerald theme, but the accent color, badge text, voice, and background a"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"re all tweakable — make it your own."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What is this"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Gives the DeepSeek Harness web UI a heavily customizable theme. **By default it's the jade-green "Xi"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ao" look** (jade palette + mascot badge + Xiao-style voice + frosted background), but every part is "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"adjustable: accent color, badge text, voice toggle/language/content, background image and transparen"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"cy. - **Mascot badge**: a draggable, collapsib"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"le badge (bottom-right); title and subtitle can be set to any text, and the avatar image can be repl"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"aced by uploading a new one. Static or GIF backgrounds never show these controls.
- **Xiao-s"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"tyle voice (work sessions)**: injects a Xiao-voice instruction into the system prompt (toggleable), "},{"id":"p16s11","text":"with Chinese / English templates or your own custom prompt. **Tone only**: the substance, tools and "},{"id":"p16s12","text":"execution stay exactly the same, and no character identity is injected.
